name: Yet Another Notification Center
author: yoyo
description: Notification history, 30-day trash, sounds, and auto-hide — sitting on Omarchy's existing notification daemon

schema.label: Unread mark
schema.description: How the bell shows notifications that arrived since you last opened the center.

schema.label: Keep history for
schema.description: Days. Older history is deleted. Trash is always 30 days.

schema.label: Show at most
schema.description: Cards on the History tab. The archive can be larger.

schema.label: Auto-hide toasts after (ms)
schema.description: 0 leaves Omarchy's own timeouts. Any other value dismisses every on-screen toast, including critical.

schema.label: Play a sound
schema.description: Omarchy's daemon is silent. This plays a freedesktop sound when a notification is archived.
